subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers refresh the existing conflicting fork PR for this issue, or supersede it with a new narrow same-repo repair?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but an open closing-syntax fork PR and the existing no-new-fix-pr label mean automation should not start another fix path until maintainers choose how to handle that branch.

options.title: Replace With Same-Repo Repair
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor one focused OpenClaw PR with regression coverage for custom prompts, default prompts, and transcript-marker behavior.

options.title: Refresh The Fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or an owner to rebase the branch, resolve conflicts, and add current real behavior proof before review.

options.title: Pause For Owner Triage
options.body: Keep this issue open without new repair automation until a heartbeat owner decides the permanent prompt-boundary shape.

recommendation.title: Replace With Same-Repo Repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor one focused OpenClaw PR with regression coverage for custom prompts, default prompts, and transcript-marker behavior.
